card.name: Start of web addresses and names
card.fires_on: The 'www' right after 'http://' in reference lists and citations. Also the end or middle of proper names, such as species names, 'DR' before a surname, and 'JEAN' in an author credit.

modes.label: www after http://
modes.description: The 'www' that follows 'http://' in a cited web address.

modes.label: Inside proper names
modes.description: Partway through or at the end of a Latin species name, an author's name or a title before a name.

card.writes: It pushes toward names and labels such as Western, Eastern, Ltd and Android, and away from lowercase place and language words.
card.plain: It fires on the 'www' in web links in reference lists, and on parts of scientific and personal names.
